desc: three players at the prologue's end (Rogueport, Goombella only): player 3 gets a lent partner (Koops, as a tag-along), walks it, hops, presses X (no field ability: nothing happens), L for the next lent one (Flurrie). Shots: lent_out (Koops beside Mario, '3P' over him), p3_walked (Koops away from Mario, Goombella idle), p3_next (Flurrie in Koops's place)
